source.source_description: A tanuló által bemásolt Duolingo webes Guidebook-szöveg, 7. modul, 1–180. rész (#646–#825).
source.note: A forrás angol kulcskifejezéseket tartalmaz, magyar fordításokat nem. A 180 egység 36 egymást követő, ötegységes blokkban ismétli a címeket és a példamondatokat; mind a 180 egység külön azonosítóval szerepel, a közös mondatanyag deduplikált phrase_sets alatt van. A phrase_sets 187 egyedi angol példamondatot tartalmaz.

module.title_hu: Összetettebb társas, munkahelyi és hipotetikus kommunikáció

english_examples: I'm allowed to go as long as I'm home by 10.
Then, can I go to the game on Saturday instead?
Do you think I'd be able to go out later?
That would be fine, just remember to call me.
Hey, I told you not to borrow the car!
Did you say you could recommend a good dentist?
Yes, my dentist said she could see you next week.
A hot shower can really relax your muscles.
To avoid infection, change the bandage every day.
Supposedly, drinking water with lemon is good for you!

grammar_observations.topic: reported speech: could recommend / said she could

english_examples: Does the landlord know you're moving?
The house on the corner is my dream house!
Wouldn't you need more bedrooms?
The real estate agent said she'd keep us in mind.
I'd love a living room with a big stone fireplace.
You should've admitted you were wrong.
You could've tried to understand his position.
Let's not forget what happened last time.
Are you saying the argument was a big misunderstanding?
Yes, let's not argue about this anymore.

grammar_observations.topic: should have + past participle: múltbeli kritika/tanács
could have + past participle: elmulasztott lehetőség

english_examples: Are you excited to start your new job?
Absolutely, without a doubt!
I can definitely complete that project.
Now that we've agreed, let's discuss next steps.
Do you want to meet at a certain time?
Could we maybe meet at 4?
How often should these plants be watered?
I planted some seeds there, so don't step on them!
This is a good spot to plant the carrots.
Should I transfer it to a bigger pot?
The gardener says it's too cold here to grow strawberries.

grammar_observations.topic: modal + be + past participle: passzív kérdés

english_examples: Let's go somewhere tropical!
Aren't there mosquitos in tropical areas?
Bring lots of sunscreen so you don't get a sunburn.
He can get there much more quickly if he flies.
If we don't book now, everything will be sold out!

grammar_observations.topic: future passive: will be sold out

english_examples: I haven't seen you in ages!
I can't get over how much you've changed!
The man engaged to Frida is nice.
Do you know whose seat this is?
It makes me happy to look back on those years.
That's Mr. Lee, whose first name I can't remember!
Will you be following the election results?
Healthcare is an important issue in this campaign.
She'll be making her speech at seven.
By next month, we'll have chosen the new president.
I'm not sure which candidate I'm going to be voting for.
You voted to pass a law that increased taxes, didn't you?

grammar_observations.topic: be going to in embedded clause

english_examples: If the sun comes out, there might be a rainbow.
It'll be covered in snow.
It's possible that it'll rain tomorrow.
It's awful that it's going to rain on their wedding day.
It'd be fun to go skiing if it snows.
Will the show be canceled because of the rain?

grammar_observations.topic: second conditional: it'd be fun if...

english_examples: They could fire you for sending that email!
Be careful not to fall off the edge.
I like you, but I don't want to risk our friendship.
He said he'd be careful not to let it happen again.
Don't risk it all!
He'll have to accept the consequences.
Please help your sister clear the table.
But I cleared the table last time!
Shouldn't he be picking up the kids soon?
Feeding the dog is one of my daily responsibilities.
Any chance you could fill up the tank?
It's a myth that you can afford anything you want here.
My first impression was that everyone had a truck!
Oh, that's a myth!
It's a lot more diverse than I expected.
It seems that everyone loves football except me.
No, not necessarily.

grammar_observations.topic: it is a myth that + clause

english_examples: The presentation was an embarrassment to the company.
I wish it'd never happened.
If only I had ignored him instead of starting an argument.
I wish I had known sooner.
It turns out that we were both sorry about what happened.

grammar_observations.topic: wish + would: kívánt változás/múltbeli eseményre utaló alak

english_examples: Were you able to follow today's lecture?
Have you chosen your thesis topic yet?
My thesis is about how the media has changed society.
That class was stressful from the start!
Law students have to take a philosophy class, right?
Remember when we stayed up all night?
We were young and irresponsible back then.
What made the trip memorable?
We'd ride horses and swim in the lake every day.
What would you do on weekends?
We'd wake up really early to go fishing.
How cute is this neighborhood!
I liked their new house, but how tiny was that bathroom!
My dress was in style years ago, but now it looks strange.
There's nothing better than Aunt Mia's homemade cookies!
Sounds more exciting than sitting at home alone!
The reason that I called is to discuss an urgent matter.
Can you believe our hours were cut again?
Completely unacceptable!
The point is it's time to try some new strategies.
The work itself shouldn't be too hard.
Once we get the signatures, we'll open the account.

grammar_observations.topic: the reason that + clause / purpose infinitive
once time clause + future main clause

english_examples: We never place the dessert spoon next to the salad fork.
I can't cancel after having invited everyone!
A good host makes people feel welcome.
Make sure that every table has a clean tablecloth.
After having set the table, you can wait for the guests.

grammar_observations.topic: after having + past participle: perfect gerund

english_examples: I got a sunburn yesterday, and it really itches now!
He sounds as though he has a sore throat.
I sometimes get severe headaches.
Do you notice any weakness in that arm?
He's been acting a little strange lately.
This house didn't have plumbing until 1926.
I'm worried that it'll need a lot of maintenance.
If we remove this wall, we could extend the living room.
There was a crack that went from the floor to the ceiling.
Are you feeling relieved now that doors have been installed?

grammar_observations.topic: first conditional-like if + present, could consequence

english_examples: I would share practically every detail of my day with him.
You have to communicate your needs!
It looks like you've finally reached an agreement!
I know you dislike him, but try to keep an open mind.
After walking for hours, we saw the village up ahead.
Just as he was starting to celebrate, he heard a scream!
They hid until the monster was no longer awake.
Do you know the legend of King Arthur?
Yes, people have been telling that tale for generations.
Reaching my goal was surprisingly easy!
If I wanted to reach my goal, I would have to work harder.
I needed to work at improving my English.
I've had to work at managing my time.
The more I read about clowns, the more I wanted to be one.

grammar_observations.topic: second conditional / hypothetical if + Past Simple, would
the more..., the more... correlative comparative

english_examples: She mentioned Luis had said something odd.
No one has a clue why they split up.
Did she claim she hadn't seen his message yet?
Max swore he'd already broken up with Amy.
I heard they held hands all evening.
We had been walking for hours.
The building was falling apart, so we had to be careful.
When I tried to turn on my flashlight, nothing happened!
After I had been hiding inside, the sky looked so bright.
She's constantly practicing the violin late at night!
That must be really annoying!
Why are they always ruining our parties?
The issue is that we can't sleep with all this noise!
Who's going to take responsibility for all this trash?
I couldn't stay in New York because I was in too much debt.
Moving to Boston had a big impact on my life.
Consequently, the situation improved.
Moving into my parents' house made me reflect on my life!
The more I relied on my folks, the less independent I felt.

grammar_observations.topic: the more..., the less... correlative comparative

english_examples: The show has sort of a weird plot.
Is it the one where a worker deceives her boss?
The main character is sort of a mean guy.
It's kind of like that movie we watched together.
Who's the villain that's always threatening everyone?
We should rewatch that one episode where Max escapes!
Police are investigating the crash.
Luckily, no one was injured.
She got to shore in spite of the storm.
No one expected a hurricane!

grammar_observations.topic: in spite of + noun phrase: concession

english_examples: I've always had a suspicion that they're more than friends.
Something that she said really hurt my feelings.
From my point of view, this is a big mistake.
Nothing that he suggests will change my opinion.
Isn't it a bit soon to propose to her?
Everything she said about the breakup sounded awful.

grammar_observations.topic: from my point of view: stance phrase

english_examples: Everyone makes errors from time to time.
Would watching your favorite show cheer you up?
Everybody that works here loves you, honey.
I know it's tough, but I believe in you!
Let me add one thing.
Sorry about that, my phone was ringing in the other room.
I want to get back to our chat about the election.
I can tell you love politics, but can't we talk about music?
That reminds me, I want to hear about your new job!
Wait, isn't she a student of your mom's?

grammar_observations.topic: double genitive: a student of your mom's

english_examples: I'm sure we can negotiate an agreement.
Will I get paid overtime if I work on the weekends?
You'll need to submit a request first.
What are the benefits of getting certified?
If you get certified, you'll get a raise.
How could you break my favorite keychain?
I heard you lying to Mom!
Admit that you ripped my poster on purpose!
José put the fork in the microwave, not me!
What in the world am I going to do with you two?

grammar_observations.topic: what in the world: emphatic wh-expression

english_examples: If you had a superpower, what would it be?
It'd be so cool if I could fly!
If she hadn't had the accident, she wouldn't be a superhero.
He would have died if he didn't have a special suit.
If you were Professor Green, what would you have done?

grammar_observations.topic: mixed conditional: past result + present condition
mixed conditional: would have + if + Past Simple

source_conflicts.note: A bemásolt angol kulcskifejezésekhez nem érkezett magyar fordítás.
A 180 helyi egység 36 egymást követő ötegységes blokkban ismétli a címeket és példamondatokat. A phrase_sets 36 egyedi témacsoportot, a units mind a 180 külön részt tárolja.
